message.reasoning_content:
The tie-direction claim is already recorded (c1, same source line). This claim is already in the ledger; don't duplicate. Are there other high-value testable claims? bf16 reduced-precision ties — same root cause. The risk map also flags a subtle second bug: `tl.where(cols == e, x, 0.0)` with other=-inf padded positions... actually v extraction: positions other than e contribute 0.0, fine. But note: when x[e] is -inf and e... fine.

Actually there's another real bug: `v = tl.sum(tl.where(cols==e, x, 0.0))` — if x[e] equals... no.

Another: best = -inf and -inf >= -inf tie case (all-(-inf)) — reference argmax in PyTorch returns 0 for all-(-inf). Contract silent? The contract only covers ties of the largest logit; all -inf rows are edge. Unknown scope.

Also for fp16/bf16: `other=-float("inf")` cast fine.

I think one more distinct in-scope claim could be: the `>=` bug also affects partial ties (not just all-equal), e.g. two experts tied at max among more experts — but that's the same claim c1 essentially. I'll record no new claims.
